title: A practical packing timeline
excerpt: Spread packing across a few clear stages so essential items remain usable and the final week is reserved for checks, not rushed decisions.

paragraphs.text: Start with storage areas and items you do not use every week. Decide what will move, what will be donated and what needs specialist handling before boxes begin to gather.
Pack room by room and label each box with both its destination and a short description. Keep fixings, cables and small parts in clearly marked bags with the item they belong to.
Confirm the moving-day access plan and set aside documents, medication, chargers and overnight essentials that should travel with you.
Close and label the last everyday boxes, photograph useful cable layouts and leave cleaning supplies accessible. A short final inventory makes the next morning calmer.
